milan-day-archive.title: Milan Day 2-Digit Historical Archive (1992–2026)
milan-day-archive.source: User-provided Milan Day Chart workbook (PDF-derived; date-wise weekly records)
milan-day-archive.coverage_note: Weekly date ranges absent from the source chart are intentionally omitted where the market did not publish a weekly record (including holidays/market closures as confirmed by the user). Do not auto-fill these periods or infer Jodi results. Blank weekday cells within a published week mean no number was shown in the source.
